reference_text: No added sugar. Sounds like sugar-free... right? Well... not quite. Fruit juice can still contain sugar from the fruit. So turn the pack over. Check total sugars, then compare similar drinks per hundred millilitres. Small flip. Better information.
script: You bought a detox tea. Your organs weren't informed.
This box just applied for a job... that's already taken.
Your liver processes harmful substances. Your kidneys filter waste and extra water from your blood.
Those commercial detox cleanses? There's no convincing evidence they remove toxins.
Like tea? Choose an ordinary brew for the taste. Skip the cleansing promise. The real team? Already on the job.
